messages.subject: downloadHandler
parts:
Hello, anyone knows if is it possible to download multiple sheet xlsx file with the downloadHandler? And further also to specify another datapath than the temp folder? Thank you for feedback.
Carolina

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: downloadHandler
parts: You'd need to combine the multiple files into a single zip using zip(). And you can't specify a different datapath, but you can copy the data you want into the filename that's handed to you by Shiny.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: downloadHandler
parts:
I totally misunderstood what you were asking, sorry. I thought you meant multiple xlsx files, you meant a single xlsx file with multiple sheets. It looks to me like you should be able to use the xslx package's write.xlsx/write.xlsx2 functions to write multiple data frames to an xslx file, each one as a different sheet.
http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/xlsx/xlsx.pdf
